newsitem.title: USA: UAL to exchange securities for PFD stock.
newsitem.headline: UAL to exchange securities for PFD stock.

text.p: UAL Corp announced on Friday an offer to exchange 13.25-percent Trust Originated Preferred Securities (TOPrS) for outstanding depositary shares of 12.25-percent UAL Corp Series B preferred stock.
The exchange offer period expires at midnight EST on Dec 20, 1996, unless extended, the company said.
The TOPrS wil be issued by UAL Corp Capital Trust I, a Delaware statutory business trust that serves as a finance vehicle for UAL Corp.
The trust's asset will consist of a new issue of junior subordinated debentures of UAL Corp due 2026, and TOPrS represent a preferred undivided beneficial interest in the trust.
Under the offer, each UAL Corp Series B depositary share held can be exchanged for one TOPrS. Each Series B depositary share represents 1/1,000 of a share of the UAL Corp Series B preferred stock.

The trust will accept all 6.3 million Series B depositary shares not owned by UAL Corp, subject to certain conditions, including that at least one million Series B depositary shares be tendered for exchange, the company said.
The company said it is conducting the exchange to refinance the Series B depositary shares with TOPrS "while preserving UAL Corporation's flexibility in respect to futures financing."
Merrill Lynch & Co and Smith Barney Inc are the dealer managers. The Bank of New York is the exchange agent.
